body: The owner approved the Android fix spec on 2026-09-24, and it was handed to mitosis as asked.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Run setup**, all under ~/.mitosis/field-notes/android-fixes/:U+000AU+002D CHARTER.mdU+000AU+002D accept.zsh, the Flutter acceptance wrapper. It was verified in a probe:U+000A  U+002D failing assertion → 1U+000A  U+002D missing API compile error in the test → 1U+000A  U+002D lib compile error → 2U+000A  U+002D no matching test → 2U+000A  U+002D pass → 0U+000AU+002D pr_adapter.py, which goes through ~/.claude/lib/git/pr.mjs pr-create, validates titles against PR_TITLE_PATTERN, then runs `gh pr ready --undo` to make each PR a draft.U+000AU+002D dispatch.zsh, which sets CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS=0 and appends worker-rules.txt: foreground only, no git stash, no comments, protected paths.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Run command:** --items docs/specs/android-e2e-defect-fixes.items.json --feature-branch feat/composer-editor-core, with tiers top=claude-opus-5-5 and cheap=claude-sonnet-5, --timeout 3600, --concurrency 4, --graph graphify-out/graph.json. The run dir is ~/.mitosis/runs/field-notes/2026-09-24-android-fixes and the log is run2.log.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Delivery regrouping.** It is recorded in the decisions file and changes no behaviour. The plan first fused MSPs that shared files:U+000AU+002D B1 now adds both platform-interface dev dependencies, so video-recorder stacks on video-playback.U+000AU+002D The Settings-file copy fixes and the settings-row accessibility fix ride in the settings-screen MSP.U+000AU+002D C6 rides with the mood-banner label fix in accessibility.U+000AU+000AThe final plan has 38 Steps, 26 Lanes and 12 MSPs, with the four Must MSPs alone.U+000AU+000AU+002A*First launch.** It exited 5 with no work done. The old composer run still holds a `mitosis/settings` worktree, so the group was renamed to settings-screen. The first launch's 11 empty worktrees and branches, all at 9b80901 and clean, were removed. The old run's 27 `mitosis/*` branches and worktrees are untouched.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Second launch.** Running, with 4 workers active.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Phone:** the keep-awake watcher is stopped. The plain app holds a probe build that includes the receivers, and its test data was cleared with Delete all.
